description:
mymemories.888 is an app to tag specific moments of the day using a wearable (The crown, Aura ring, Apple watch, etc). At the end of the day, Users can write some notes or audio as a diary to remember it. Everything is encrypted and only the owner decides what and to whom you share your data (of the wearable and your habits as anonymously as you want).

how_its_made:
User sign with walletConnect and upload data to IPFS. smart contracts are deployed on polygon.

The project has helped us to begin to learn the potential that web3 has to solve issues such as privacy, security and computing capacity.

Our approach during the project was more focused on validating with users and understanding how to build it in the most decentralized way possible.
